driver_belt_pulley.name: Small Driver Pulley (High Angular Velocity ω₁)
driver_belt_pulley.description: Smaller pulley of radius r₁ rotating at higher angular speed ω₁ while sharing tangential belt speed v = r₁ω₁ = r₂ω₂.

drive_belt.name: Endless Transmission Belt
drive_belt.description: Taut flexible belt connecting the two pulleys so that both rims travel with equal linear tangential speed v.

driven_belt_pulley.name: Large Driven Pulley (Radius r₂)
driven_belt_pulley.description: Larger pulley of radius r₂ that rotates at lower angular velocity ω₂ but delivers increased torque.

meshing_spur_gears.name: Meshing Spur Gear Train (Pinion & Gear)
meshing_spur_gears.description: Interlocking toothed gears that reverse rotational direction and transmit angular motion according to N₁ω₁ = N₂ω₂.

input_master_piston.name: Small Input Piston (Master Cylinder, Area A₁)
input_master_piston.description: Small cross-sectional area piston where an input effort force F₁ creates fluid pressure P = F₁ / A₁.

output_slave_piston.name: Large Output Piston & Load (Slave Cylinder, Area A₂)
output_slave_piston.description: Large cross-sectional area piston that multiplies upward output force F₂ = F₁(A₂ / A₁) to lift heavy loads.

incompressible_hydraulic_fluid.name: Incompressible Hydraulic Fluid (Pascal's Principle)
incompressible_hydraulic_fluid.description: Enclosed incompressible liquid that transmits applied pressure equally in all directions throughout the system.
